debug.changelog:
refactor: improve BackupScreen UI and cleanup DashboardScreen imports

- Refactored `BackupScreen` to separate state management from UI content, improving maintainability.
- Replaced fixed bottom action buttons with a Floating Action Button (FAB) pattern for export and import actions.
- Added descriptive icons to backup categories in the settings list.
- Migrated UI state collection to `collectAsStateWithLifecycle` for better lifecycle awareness.
- Cleaned up numerous unused imports and icon references in `DashboardScreen.kt`.
- Adjusted layout padding and structure in `BackupScreen` to better handle system bars and overlapping UI elements.

Update launcher icon visuals

Refines the app launcher icon by updating foreground and background gradients to a new blue-purple-red color scheme. Adjusts the foreground shadow, reduces body stroke width, and adds a subtle inner highlight rim for improved depth.
